narrative: While price and value is the top‑scoring blocker, we cannot address it with discounts, so the next most actionable area is Quality & Material Concerns, which shows the highest opportunity score among addressable themes and appears in both app reviews and Reddit posts. A surprising finding is that Reddit users raise distinct themes such as Styling & Versatility and Wishlist Capacity Limits that are absent from the app‑store feedback, highlighting a gap between channels. The other high‑scoring areas—Fit & Comfort, Delivery & Service Experience, and Trust Signals—still carry “not enough data yet” labels, meaning the insights are promising but unproven rather than irrelevant. Prioritizing improvements to product quality and material transparency can therefore deliver impact without relying on price levers.
